record_type: Historical source identity, reading observations and bounded retrieval coverage
scope: Source checks for the bracketed editorial instructions in the author checkpoint 7725265. No optional archival batch, historical code execution, site export, publication, or remote push.

online_sources.title: RFC 675, December 1974
online_sources.finding_and_limit: Existing internetwork TCP specification before the AUTODIN II deliverable; checked online text.

online_sources.title: RFC 694, June 18, 1975
online_sources.locator: TCP entry, printed pp. 8–10, particularly May 30 entry on p. 10
online_sources.finding_and_limit: BBN-TENEXA running implementation; Stanford debugging and UCL coding. Printed schedule statements and reported current status remain distinct.

online_sources.title: IEN 151, April 1, 1980
online_sources.finding_and_limit: Stanford contract July 1973–September 1976, BBN design and implementation participation, and intermediate AUTODIN II specification. Used for those facts, not to override dates of original protocol editions.

online_sources.title: Vint Cerf, A Brief History of the Internet & Related Networks
online_sources.locator: Opening section, public-domain and commercial implementations paragraph
online_sources.finding_and_limit: Participant retrospective; identifies both kinds of implementation in the 1980s, not universal free availability.

online_sources.title: Barry Leiner et al., A Brief History of the Internet, 1997
online_sources.locator: Origins of the Internet; Proving the Ideas
online_sources.finding_and_limit: Participant retrospective; BBN IMP contract and DARPA-supported BBN/Berkeley software distribution. No claim of first implementation among all competing protocols.

online_sources.title: RFC 801, November 1981
online_sources.finding_and_limit: Planned transition by January 1, 1983; does not independently verify every host completed the transition.

online_sources.title: Cerf and Kahn, A Protocol for Packet Network Intercommunication, May 1974
online_sources.locator: 13-page reprint; PDF pp. 12–13, conclusion, acknowledgment and references

online_sources.title: DARPA, ARPANET retrospective
online_sources.locator: Passage on Kahn hiring Cerf in 1976
online_sources.finding_and_limit: Used for Cerf appointment date only; does not date establishment of the Internetting program.

online_sources.title: RFC 827, October 1982
online_sources.finding_and_limit: Core gateway system on ARPANET and SATNET, distinct from the underlying packet-switching networks.

online_sources.title: RFC 820, January 1983
online_sources.locator: Assigned Autonomous System Numbers, printed p. 11
online_sources.finding_and_limit: AS 1 listed as The BBN Gateways; other usable values unassigned. Header names J. Postel and J. Vernon. No inference about a numbered autonomous system intrinsic to the ARPANET switching backbone.

online_sources.title: DISA, Our History
online_sources.locator: Connecting through the Cold War; A New Era: The Defense Information Systems Agency
online_sources.finding_and_limit: Agency retrospective used for common-user responsibilities and June 25, 1991 renaming.

online_sources.title: RFC 9293, August 2022
online_sources.finding_and_limit: Obsolete TCP precedence processing; Class Selector compatibility and specialized MLS treatment.

online_sources.title: RFC 2474, December 1998
online_sources.finding_and_limit: IP precedence history and Class Selector compatibility; no claim of unchanged AUTODIN II semantics.

local_sources.finding: July 1977 meeting account of Cerf proposing replacement of cross-country links and regional networks joined through gateways.

local_sources.locator: ANEWS-1, July 1, 1980, opening and Access Policy
local_sources.finding: Transfers of some subscribers projected from 1983; residual ARPANET and commercial networks included; access restrictions do not establish expulsion of all civilian users.

local_sources.locator: Executive Summary of draft committee review, August 26–27, 1975 meeting
local_sources.finding: Collective committee recommendations, advisory capacity and draft status.

local_sources.locator: DDN Program Plan, printed p. iii
local_sources.finding: DCA tasking September 1981; joint CCTC and industry effort; April 2, 1982 termination; abridged edition.
Joint DCA/CCTC and industry design team. Does not identify BBN as sole author or label the plan a procurement proposal.

local_sources.locator: DSB Task Force report, December 1982, printed p. 3 / PDF p. 11
Introduction and opening recommendations; photographed source paths embedded in extract
local_sources.finding: Earlier common-user planning and distinction from AUTODIN I message switching. No fresh visual coverage of original BBN photographs claimed.
